item.title: Windows POS 1.0.9+17
item.description:
# Windows POS 1.0.9+17
- Choose cart service using a radio dialog with Apply and Cancel. - Add Laundry Only at 100% of the Base unit price multiplied by quantity; upcharges and alterations are added separately. - Preserve the Base price across service changes and order reloads. - Keep different services on separate cart lines; preserve service pricing when replacing a garment. - Print Laundry Only on customer and store invoices and preserve the service in POS delivery projections.
Validation: 19 focused tests passed; static analysis found no errors; Windows release build and local installation verified.
